control.title: Ensure the API server pod specification file permissions are 600 or more restrictive
control.description: A world-readable/writable static-pod manifest lets a node-local user read secrets or alter how the API server starts.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the API server pod specification file ownership is set to root:root
control.description: Incorrect ownership of the manifest allows tampering with control-plane startup.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false
control.description: Anonymous requests to the API server bypass authentication entirely.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --token-auth-file parameter is not set
control.description: Static token files are long-lived, unrotatable bearer credentials; prefer short-lived, pluggable auth.
control.remediation: Remove --token-auth-file and use OIDC/webhook or client-cert auth.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow
control.description: AlwaysAllow disables authorization, granting every authenticated caller full access.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --authorization-mode argument includes Node
control.description: The Node authorizer restricts what kubelets can read/write to only their own node's objects.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --authorization-mode argument includes RBAC
control.description: RBAC is the baseline for least-privilege authorization in Kubernetes.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit is not set
control.description: AlwaysAdmit admits every request, defeating admission-time policy enforcement.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the admission control plugin NodeRestriction is set
control.description: NodeRestriction limits a compromised kubelet to modifying only its own node and pods.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --profiling argument is set to false
control.description: The profiling endpoint exposes sensitive runtime detail and widens the attack surface.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --audit-log-path argument is set
control.description: Without an audit log there is no record of who did what — required by most frameworks.
control.remediation: Set --audit-log-path (and retention/rotation flags) on the kube-apiserver.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --encryption-provider-config argument is set
control.description: Without encryption-at-rest configuration, Secrets are stored in etcd in plaintext.
control.remediation: Set --encryption-provider-config and enable a kms/aescbc provider.

results.evidence: Control Plane controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --cert-file and --key-file arguments are set for etcd
control.description: Without server TLS, etcd — which stores all cluster state including Secrets — accepts plaintext connections.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true for etcd
control.description: Without client certificate auth, any client that reaches etcd can read/modify all cluster state.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --auto-tls argument is not set to true for etcd
control.description: auto-tls makes etcd generate self-signed certs and accept them, undermining mutual authentication.
control.remediation: Do not set --auto-tls=true; provision proper certificates.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file arguments are set for etcd
control.description: Peer TLS protects replication traffic between etcd members from interception.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --peer-client-cert-auth argument is set to true for etcd
control.description: Without peer client-cert auth, a rogue peer can join and read/modify cluster state.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the --peer-auto-tls argument is not set to true for etcd
control.description: peer-auto-tls disables verification of peer identities.

results.evidence: etcd controls are managed by the eks provider; not customer-scored

control.title: Ensure the kubelet config file permissions are 600 or more restrictive
control.description: A readable kubelet config can leak sensitive parameters; a writable one lets a local user weaken the node.

results.evidence: /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml permissions 0600 within 0600

control.title: Ensure the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (kubelet)
control.description: Anonymous access to the kubelet API allows unauthenticated command execution in pods.

results.evidence: kubelet --anonymous-auth=false

control.title: Ensure the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (kubelet)
control.description: AlwaysAllow on the kubelet grants every caller full access to node/pod APIs.

results.evidence: kubelet authorization-mode is not AlwaysAllow

control.title: Ensure the --client-ca-file argument is set (kubelet)
control.description: Without a client CA the kubelet cannot verify API-server client certificates.

results.evidence: kubelet client CA file is configured

control.title: Ensure the --read-only-port argument is set to 0
control.description: The read-only port (10255) exposes pod and node data without authentication.

results.evidence: kubelet read-only port is disabled

control.title: Ensure the --streaming-connection-idle-timeout argument is not set to 0
control.description: A zero idle timeout leaves exec/attach/port-forward streams open indefinitely, a resource-exhaustion vector.
control.remediation: Set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to a non-zero value (e.g. 5m).

results.evidence: kubelet streaming connection idle timeout is non-zero

control.title: Ensure the --make-iptables-util-chains argument is set to true
control.description: Letting the kubelet manage iptables ensures the expected packet-filtering chains exist.

results.evidence: kubelet manages iptables util chains (default)

control.title: Ensure that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true
control.description: Server certificate rotation limits the blast radius of a leaked kubelet serving cert.
control.remediation: Enable RotateKubeletServerCertificate on the kubelet and controller-manager.

results.evidence: kubelet server certificate rotation is enabled

control.title: Ensure that the cluster-admin role is only used where required
control.description: cluster-admin is unbounded superuser; broad or unnecessary bindings make one compromise total.
control.remediation: Replace cluster-admin bindings with least-privilege roles; restrict to break-glass identities.

results.evidence: cluster-admin is bound only to system:masters

control.title: Minimize wildcard use in Roles and ClusterRoles
control.description: Wildcard verbs/resources/apiGroups grant blanket access that makes privilege escalation trivial.
control.remediation: Enumerate the specific apiGroups/resources/verbs each role needs; remove '*'.

results.evidence: no wildcard permissions in collected roles

control.title: Ensure that default service accounts are not actively used
control.description: Workloads using the default SA (with token automount) get ambient credentials they rarely need.
control.remediation: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false on default SAs and use per-workload SAs.

results.evidence: default ServiceAccounts disable token automount

control.title: Minimize the admission of privileged containers (Pod Security)
control.description: Namespaces without an enforced baseline/restricted Pod Security level admit privileged pods.
control.remediation: Enable Pod Security Admission and label namespaces enforce=baseline or restricted.

results.evidence: all workload namespaces enforce baseline/restricted Pod Security

control.title: Ensure that all namespaces have network policies defined
control.description: Without a NetworkPolicy a namespace allows unrestricted pod-to-pod traffic (flat network).
control.remediation: Define default-deny NetworkPolicies in every workload namespace.

results.evidence: every workload namespace has at least one NetworkPolicy

control.title: Ensure that the default namespace is not used for workloads
control.description: Concentrating workloads in the default namespace defeats namespace-scoped policy and RBAC boundaries.
control.remediation: Place workloads in dedicated namespaces with their own policies and quotas.

results.evidence: the default namespace is not used for workloads
